shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣站在一台大型立式高压灭菌器旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a large vertical laboratory autoclave with its door closed, smiling at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课：高压灭菌器与压力容器。
overlay: 高压灭菌器与压力容器

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣指着压力表
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at the round pressure gauge on the front of the autoclave.
shots.narration: 高温、高压、蒸汽，三样都要防。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰把拧紧盖子的玻璃瓶放进灭菌器
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts glass bottles with tightly screwed caps into an autoclave basket.
shots.narration: 阿杰要灭菌培养基，瓶盖拧得死紧。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 灭菌结束他就想开门
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the young male student reaching for the autoclave door handle while the pressure gauge needle is still high, a question mark above. No text.
shots.narration: 时间一到，压力还没降就想开门。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 王老师按住门，指着压力表
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator stops him at the door and points to the pressure gauge.
shots.narration: 王老师：瓶会炸，蒸汽会烫伤！

shots.section_title: 灭菌设备失修会出事：定期维护和校准
shots.scene: 灭菌器和辐照装置，故障图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an autoclave and an irradiation unit with broken gear icons and a warning triangle. No text.
shots.narration: 灭菌设备失修，会出故障甚至事故。
overlay: 灭菌设备失修会出事：定期维护和校准

shots.section_title: 灭菌设备失修会出事：定期维护和校准
shots.scene: 老李按计划维护灭菌器
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer services an autoclave following a maintenance plan, checking the door gasket and drain.
shots.narration: 按计划维护，交给专业人员。

shots.section_title: 灭菌设备失修会出事：定期维护和校准
shots.scene: 门封老化、排气不畅图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an aged cracked door gasket and a blocked exhaust pipe on an autoclave, with a warning triangle. No text.
shots.narration: 门封老化、排气不畅，既危险又灭不透。

shots.section_title: 灭菌设备失修会出事：定期维护和校准
shots.scene: 压力表、安全阀定期校验，贴合格标识
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a pressure gauge and a safety valve each with a blank calibration label and a calendar icon. No text.
shots.narration: 压力表、安全阀等，定期校验。

shots.section_title: 灭菌设备失修会出事：定期维护和校准
shots.scene: 维护校准记录本
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a maintenance and calibration logbook with blank rows and a signature line. No text.
shots.narration: 维护校准，都要留下记录。

shots.section_title: 灭菌设备失修会出事：定期维护和校准
shots.scene: 辐照装置专人持证，学生止步
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an irradiation unit room with a certified staff member at the door and a student stopped by a no entry symbol. No text.
shots.narration: 辐照装置专人持证管，学生不碰。

shots.section_title: 压力容器是特种设备：登记、检验、持证
shots.scene: 压力容器、气瓶、发酵罐图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, a large autoclave, a gas cylinder and a fermentation tank, all marked as pressure equipment. No text.
shots.narration: 灭菌器、发酵罐，有的属于压力容器。
overlay: 压力容器是特种设备：登记、检验、持证

shots.section_title: 压力容器是特种设备：登记、检验、持证
shots.scene: 法律书本和特种设备目录
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a law book and a catalogue of special equipment, an autoclave being matched to the catalogue. No text.
shots.narration: 属于特种设备的，依法管理。

shots.section_title: 压力容器是特种设备：登记、检验、持证
shots.scene: 使用登记证和定期检验合格标志
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a blank registration certificate and a blank inspection label on the side of an autoclave, a calendar icon. No text.
shots.narration: 办理使用登记，按期定期检验。

shots.section_title: 压力容器是特种设备：登记、检验、持证
shots.scene: 安全技术档案和管理责任人
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a safety technical file folder and a responsible person badge next to an autoclave. No text.
shots.narration: 建立安全技术档案，明确管理责任人。

shots.section_title: 压力容器是特种设备：登记、检验、持证
shots.scene: 小型台式灭菌器和大型立式灭菌器对比，问号
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a small benchtop autoclave and a large vertical autoclave side by side with a catalogue and a question mark. No text.
shots.narration: 是否属于特种设备，按目录和本校认定。

shots.section_title: 压力容器是特种设备：登记、检验、持证
shots.scene: 检验标志过期，停用打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an expired inspection label on an autoclave, the machine tagged out of use. No text.
shots.narration: 检验过期，停止使用。

shots.section_title: 压力容器是特种设备：登记、检验、持证
shots.scene: 持证人员操作，无证打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a certified operator with a blank certificate card at an autoclave, and a person without a card crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 培训授权，按规定持证操作。

shots.section_title: 用前检查，装载松盖留缝
shots.scene: 【实拍】冷态空灭菌器：检查门封圈、水位、排水滤网
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: gloved hands checking the door gasket, the water level window and the drain strainer of a cold empty autoclave.
shots.narration: 用前检查门封、水位和排水口。
overlay: 用前检查，装载松盖留缝

shots.section_title: 用前检查，装载松盖留缝
shots.scene: 压力表、安全阀状态正常
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a pressure gauge at rest and a safety valve with a tick, a cracked gasket crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 压力表、安全阀正常，有问题不开机。

shots.section_title: 用前检查，装载松盖留缝
shots.scene: 【实拍】把瓶盖拧松的玻璃瓶放进灭菌筐（冷态、空瓶）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: hands loosening the caps of glass bottles a little and placing them into an autoclave basket.
shots.narration: 瓶盖拧松，让蒸汽能进能出。

shots.section_title: 用前检查，装载松盖留缝
shots.scene: 拧紧的瓶子在锅里炸裂，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a tightly capped bottle bursting inside an autoclave, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 瓶盖拧死，会在锅里炸裂。

shots.section_title: 用前检查，装载松盖留缝
shots.scene: 废物袋口留缝，放在耐热托盘里
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a biohazard waste bag with its neck loosely open, standing in a heat resistant tray. No text.
shots.narration: 废物袋口留缝，放进耐热托盘。

shots.section_title: 用前检查，装载松盖留缝
shots.scene: 装载松散留间隙，液体不装太满
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an autoclave chamber loaded loosely with gaps between items and bottles only partly filled. No text.
shots.narration: 装载松散，液体别装太满。

shots.section_title: 用前检查，装载松盖留缝
shots.scene: 液体用液体程序，慢排气
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two program icons, dry goods and liquid bottles, the liquid program with a slow exhaust arrow. No text.
shots.narration: 液体选液体程序，慢排气防溢出。

shots.section_title: 用前检查，装载松盖留缝
shots.scene: 密封容器、抽真空的平底瓶打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a sealed jar and a flat bottomed flask under vacuum, both crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 密封容器不进锅；真空要用耐压瓶。

shots.section_title: 混有化学品的废物不进灭菌器
shots.scene: 废物袋里混着化学试剂瓶
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a waste bag with a small chemical reagent bottle mixed among culture plates, a magnifier over it. No text.
shots.narration: 灭菌前，先看废物里有什么。
overlay: 混有化学品的废物不进灭菌器

shots.section_title: 混有化学品的废物不进灭菌器
shots.scene: 化学品受热放出有害气体
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a chemical bottle heated inside an autoclave releasing a harmful gas cloud, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 混着化学品，加热会放出有害气体。

shots.section_title: 混有化学品的废物不进灭菌器
shots.scene: 易燃溶剂、腐蚀品、放射性物品打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three crossed out icons at an autoclave door, a flammable solvent bottle, a corrosive bottle and a radioactive container. No text.
shots.narration: 易燃、腐蚀、放射性物品，不进锅。

shots.section_title: 混有化学品的废物不进灭菌器
shots.scene: 分开收集，各走各的处置路线
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two separate containers, one for biological waste going to the autoclave and one for chemical waste going to hazardous waste storage. No text.
shots.narration: 分开收集，各走各的处置路线。

shots.section_title: 运行有人守，异常停机报告
shots.scene: 关好门，按规程选程序启动
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student closes the autoclave door, locks it and selects a program on a blank control panel.
shots.narration: 关好锁紧门，按规程选程序。
overlay: 运行有人守，异常停机报告

shots.section_title: 运行有人守，异常停机报告
shots.scene: 运行中有人在场，看压力和温度
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person staying near a running autoclave, watching the pressure gauge and a temperature gauge. No text.
shots.narration: 运行中有人值守，留意仪表。

shots.section_title: 运行有人守，异常停机报告
shots.scene: 漏汽、异响、超压报警，按停止撤离
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: steam leaking from the door seal, an alarm bell and a hand pressing the stop button, people stepping back. No text.
shots.narration: 漏汽、异响、报警，停机远离。

shots.section_title: 运行有人守，异常停机报告
shots.scene: 挂停用牌，报告负责人
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a blank out of service tag on the autoclave and a phone call to the lab supervisor. No text.
shots.narration: 挂牌停用，报告负责人报修。

shots.section_title: 压力归零、降温后开门，联锁不强开
shots.scene: 时间到，压力表指针还在高位
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a timer at zero while the pressure gauge needle is still high and steam is inside. No text.
shots.narration: 时间到了，压力不一定降下来。
overlay: 压力归零、降温后开门，联锁不强开

shots.section_title: 压力归零、降温后开门，联锁不强开
shots.scene: 程序结束提示亮起
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an autoclave control panel showing a cycle complete icon with a bell. No text.
shots.narration: 等程序结束提示，确认后再操作。

shots.section_title: 压力归零、降温后开门，联锁不强开
shots.scene: 【实拍】压力表指针归零特写（冷态设备）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: the needle of an autoclave pressure gauge resting at zero.
shots.narration: 压力归零、温度降下，再开门。

shots.section_title: 压力归零、降温后开门，联锁不强开
shots.scene: 门联锁图标，强行撬门打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a door interlock lock icon on an autoclave and a hand forcing the door with a tool, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 门联锁保护人，绝不能绕过强开。

shots.section_title: 压力归零、降温后开门，联锁不强开
shots.scene: 人站在门侧，慢慢开一条缝
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person standing to the side of the autoclave door, opening it slowly by a small gap so residual steam escapes away from the face. No text.
shots.narration: 站在门侧，先开一条缝放余汽。

shots.section_title: 压力归零、降温后开门，联锁不强开
shots.scene: 双扉灭菌器两门互锁
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a pass through autoclave with two doors on opposite sides and a lock icon linking them. No text.
shots.narration: 双扉灭菌器两门互锁，不强开。

shots.section_title: 压力归零、降温后开门，联锁不强开
shots.scene: 门锁坏了，挂牌报修，自己拆打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a broken door lock with an out of service tag, and a person taking it apart with a screwdriver crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 门锁坏了先停用报修，不自己拆。

shots.section_title: 取物防烫防蒸汽，穿戴防护
shots.scene: 热蒸汽和热瓶子烫手，危险标志
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: hot steam and hot bottles coming out of an autoclave with a hot surface warning sign. No text.
shots.narration: 蒸汽和热物，都会烫伤人。
overlay: 取物防烫防蒸汽，穿戴防护

shots.section_title: 取物防烫防蒸汽，穿戴防护
shots.scene: 【实拍】戴隔热手套、护目镜或面屏，穿实验服（冷态示范）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a person in a lab coat putting on long heat resistant gloves and a face shield in front of an autoclave.
shots.narration: 戴隔热手套和护目镜或面屏。

shots.section_title: 取物防烫防蒸汽，穿戴防护
shots.scene: 湿手套、破手套打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a wet heat resistant glove and a torn glove, both crossed out, next to a dry intact glove with a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 隔热手套要干燥完好，湿了不隔热。

shots.section_title: 取物防烫防蒸汽，穿戴防护
shots.scene: 液体瓶静置冷却，不摇晃
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: hot liquid bottles left standing on a heat resistant cart to cool, a shaking hand crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 热液体瓶先静置冷却，别摇晃。

shots.section_title: 取物防烫防蒸汽，穿戴防护
shots.scene: 取出的热物放耐热处，做提示
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: hot items placed on a heat resistant bench with a hot surface warning sign. No text.
shots.narration: 热物放在耐热处，提醒别人。

shots.section_title: 取物防烫防蒸汽，穿戴防护
shots.scene: 烫伤用流动冷水冲
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand held under cool running water from a tap. No text.
shots.narration: 被烫伤，立即用流动冷水冲。

shots.section_title: 灭菌效果要验证，每锅有记录
shots.scene: 【实拍】在灭菌包外贴指示胶带（冷态）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a hand sticking a strip of indicator tape onto a wrapped load before it goes into the autoclave.
shots.narration: 灭菌不是放进去就完事。
overlay: 灭菌效果要验证，每锅有记录

shots.section_title: 灭菌效果要验证，每锅有记录
shots.scene: 指示胶带变色对比
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two strips of indicator tape, one unchanged before and one with dark stripes after a cycle. No text.
shots.narration: 看指示物颜色有没有变。

shots.section_title: 灭菌效果要验证，每锅有记录
shots.scene: 化学和生物指示物按规定监测
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a chemical indicator strip and a small biological indicator vial placed in the centre of a load. No text.
shots.narration: 按规定做效果监测，参数以验证为准。

shots.section_title: 灭菌效果要验证，每锅有记录
shots.scene: 每锅记录：日期、物品、参数、结果、签名
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an autoclave log sheet with five blank columns and a pen. No text.
shots.narration: 每锅都记录，按规定交接处置。

shots.section_title: 灭菌效果要验证，每锅有记录
shots.scene: 指示物没变色，重新灭菌并报告
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an unchanged indicator strip, a loop arrow for repeating the cycle and a report icon. No text.
shots.narration: 指示没合格，不出锅，查原因。

shots.section_title: 承压试验也有风险
shots.scene: 承压设备试压，划出警戒区
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a pressure vessel under a pressure test with a barrier line around it and people outside the line. No text.
shots.narration: 承压设备试压，也是有风险的作业。

shots.section_title: 承压试验也有风险
shots.scene: 按方案由专业人员试压
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a trained technician with a blank test plan operating a pressure test pump. No text.
shots.narration: 按方案，由专业人员操作。

shots.section_title: 承压试验也有风险
shots.scene: 设备合格、在检验期内
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a pressure vessel with a valid inspection label and a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 设备要合格，在检验期内。

shots.section_title: 承压试验也有风险
shots.scene: 无关人员远离
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person walking toward the test area stopped by a no entry symbol. No text.
shots.narration: 试压时无关人员远离。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 登记证、检验标志、持证卡
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, a registration certificate, an inspection label and a certificate card. No text.
shots.narration: 特种设备：登记、检验、持证。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 松盖、留缝、不进化学品
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, a loose bottle cap, an open bag neck and a crossed out chemical bottle. No text.
shots.narration: 松盖留缝，化学品不进锅。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 压力表归零、隔热手套、指示胶带
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, a pressure gauge at zero, heat resistant gloves and indicator tape. No text.
shots.narration: 归零降温再开门，防烫，验证记录。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣站在烘箱和电热板旁挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a drying oven and a hot plate and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：加热设备安全。
